nextExecutableAction: Lead first validates this preflight against its packet and current source digests. Before implementation, receive the lead wave0 commit and accepted WP-22/WP-03 typed interface, migration and scenario receipts; re-inspect any changed hashes, assign the single CRM integration owner and resolve money/status/owner boundary plus migrator identifiers. Then extend accepted CRM contracts/commands/repository and implement stage/property migration + pipeline/query modules before binding Dossier board/list/owner controls; register common events/projections/search/attention/agent adapters and finally run version-bound API/UI/conflict/restart/negative controls. Preflight worker must not start any of those implementation steps.
risks: Root-owned uncommitted integration can invalidate these whole-file hashes and line anchors; a verified preflight is a current snapshot, not a future patch application receipt.
contracts.ts, commands.ts, repository.ts and Dossier files repeat across WP-22/WP-23/WP-24; ownership collision or overwrite would destroy ingestion/alias work. Root remains integration owner.

Primary schema integer minorUnits versus string amountMinor can lose precision before validation; a silently added safe-integer cap would narrow published behavior. Resolve with common contract owner.
Response scalar status versus Rox2CanonicalResult triad can falsely label queued/persisted-but-unreconciled results as live verified; map explicitly and require readback/receipt policy.
OwnerPrincipalId, ownerRef, person and CRM Contact are distinct identities; email/display-name merge or assignment-grants coupling would leak private source mail.
ROX2 assigned relation excludes crm-company today; extending it without common graph/policy owner could introduce an invalid business-owner link or unintended ACL inheritance.
Textual title/name touch aggregation and local note search are not authorized shared graph/context; reusing them unfiltered in shared brief/search can leak private metadata.
Arbitrary property JSON, currency regex-only validation and free-form stage enum/rank drift violate typed query and precise revenue requirements.
Stage retirement and company moves must serialize atomically; a FK alone does not provide explicit replacement migration or safe deleted-stage behavior.
Both proposed CRM migration filenames appear in newFiles; do not apply duplicate DDL or fabricate timestamps before migrator resolution.
Local save-before-server-ACK or independent board state bypasses revision/idempotency and can falsely report success/duplicate cards; use common controlled projection/queue.
Search/mentions/attention/agent mechanisms are full DoD, not optional merely because WP-24 has only two direct DAG edges; unaccepted common adapters prevent feature-complete claim.

Current Conation gates intentionally block edits before revision comparison; removing the block, hard-coding authenticated actor or setting live:true from fixture/proposal would violate preserved mechanisms.
All product verification remains future work by instruction. Report validation proves lineage/source freshness only, not feature behavior.
